title: Add Whisperwick to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Whisperwick](https://kreggscode.github.io/whisperwick) to games
- A pass-and-play social deduction party game for 3-10 players around one device, with an AI host that invents a new scenario every round, deals the secret roles, narrates the night and reads the votes 

Fixes #15788, fixes #15726

gist.headline: A little mystery joins game night
gist.blurb: Whisperwick joins the games collection. Gather 3–10 people around one device; the AI host handles the secrets, stories, and suspiciously confident votes.
gist.summary: Whisperwick by kreggscode joins the games collection: a pass-and-play social deduction game for 3–10 players whose AI host invents a new scenario each round, assigns secret roles, narrates the night, and reads the votes.
gist.impact: Groups get a one-device party game with fresh scenarios each round and an AI host to run the parts nobody wants to moderate.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Whisperwick as a cozy one-device mystery game: secret role cards, a glowing shared screen, and a CRT monitor robot acting as the AI host. Polli, wearing a tiny detective hat, studies a card with her friends; pixel flowers and vines keep the mystery warm rather than ominous. No project mascot or logo is identified.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art game-night scene, friends gather around one glowing device while a chunky CRT monitor robot presents secret role cards and a fresh mystery; pixel flowers and vines frame the table, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent against warm cream and soft pastels. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, wearing a tiny detective hat and studying her card alongside her friends, never oversized or insect-like, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
